text: The Patriots head to Jacksonville on Sunday afternoon facing a Jaguars team that smells blood in the water after their worst offensive showing in 11 months, with Trevor Lawrence and company expecting to exploit a Patriots unit still in the process of "finding ourselves" on defense. On the injury front, tight end Eli Raridon and safety Craig Woodson have been ruled inactive after carrying questionable designations into the game, though Raridon's return to practice this week offered some encouragement for the weeks ahead. Rookie linebacker Gabe Jacas, the second-round pick who has already made impact plays in the first two weeks, will be called upon to fill significant shoes in the middle of New England's defense as they prepare to combat Jacksonville's Cover-6 looks. Beyond the X's and O's, the Patriots will need to clean up clock management issues that have plagued them before halftime for the last two weeks—a self-acknowledged weakness they'll have to correct if they want to leave Florida with a win.
